notes: No global template selector targets an application-shell element in this cohort. Shell theme tokens and visible editor identity lifecycle are retained.
Retired templates and obsolete CV-to-Cover alternatives remain as compatibility rules; their global Cover identity is localized as well.
Root-specific acceptance selectors retain their extra specificity through a repeated local identity attribute. Body ancestor rules retain their original specificity.
Rule-group and individual-carrier counts differ because a rule group may list multiple selectors. Each global carrier is independently classified in occurrences.
